summary.text: Tom Sexton is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 19B, with a tenure beginning in 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Sexton served 26 years in the U.S. Air Force and retired as a colonel.

paragraphs.text: Tom Sexton served in the U.S. Air Force for 26 years, retiring with the rank of colonel.

He earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from the University of Minnesota and graduate degrees from Embry-Riddle University, the Air Force Air Command and Staff College and the U.S. Army War College.
His career experience includes serving as a senior leader educator at the U.S. Army War College and as vice president of Construction Management at UniversalPegasus International.
Sexton succeeded John Petersburg in District 19B in 2025 and was assigned to the Climate and Energy Finance and Policy, State Government Finance and Policy, and Capital Investment committees.
